#load data
```{r}

install.packages("WorldFlora")
library(WorldFlora)

# read in species list
P50 <- read.csv("XFT_P50_stem.csv")

# read in species list
all_species <- read.csv("all_states_species_list_07_31_2026.csv")


```

# data prep
```{r}
# filter to our species
P50_filtered <- P50 %>%
  filter(SpeciesName %in% all_species$species)

length(unique(P50_filtered$SpeciesName))

# calculate a P50 median
P50_filtered <- P50_filtered %>%
  group_by(SpeciesName) %>%
  mutate(P50_median = median(P50, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# create new data frame for P50 median for pagels test
P50_species_median <- P50_filtered %>%
  group_by(SpeciesName) %>%
  summarise(P50_median = median(P50, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# cross check species names with WFO (World Flora)

#download 'classification.csv' from https://zenodo.org/records/18007552
WFO.remember(WFO.file = "data/classification.csv",
             WFO.data = "WFO.data",
             WFO.pos = 1)

match_results <- WFO.match(
  spec.data = all_species,       # your species list dataframe
  spec.name = "species",         # column name with the species names
  WFO.data = WFO.data,
  no.dates = TRUE
)

best_matches <- WFO.one(match_results)

best_matches_clean <- best_matches %>%
  dplyr::select(species.ORIG, scientificName, taxonomicStatus, Fuzzy)

all_species <- all_species %>%
  left_join(best_matches_clean, by = c("species" = "species.ORIG"))

nrow(all_species) == nrow(best_matches)

all_species <- best_matches
sum(is.na(all_species$scientificName))   # unresolved names
table(all_species$Fuzzy)                  # exact vs fuzzy matches
table(all_species$taxonomicStatus)        # accepted vs synonym vs etc.

all_species <- all_species %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientificName))

fuzzy_check <- all_species %>%
  filter(Fuzzy == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(species, scientificName, taxonomicStatus)

View(fuzzy_check)

P50_filtered <- as.data.frame(P50_filtered)

P50_match <- WFO.match(
  spec.data = P50_filtered,
  spec.name = "SpeciesName",
  WFO.data = WFO.data,
  no.dates = TRUE
) 

P50_best <- WFO.one(P50_match)

nrow(P50_filtered) == nrow(P50_best)
sum(is.na(P50_best$scientificName))
table(P50_best$Fuzzy)

P50_filtered <- P50_best %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientificName))


# recompute species median using standardized names
P50_species_median <- P50_filtered %>%
  group_by(scientificName) %>%
  summarise(P50_median = median(P50, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

save.image()
load(".RData")

save.image(file = "my_workspace.RData")
load("my_workspace.RData")
```

# build phylogeny
```{r}
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("jinyizju/V.PhyloMaker2")
library(V.PhyloMaker2)

phylo_input <- all_species %>%
  distinct(scientificName, genus, family) %>%
  dplyr::rename(species = scientificName)

nrow(phylo_input)
length(unique(phylo_input$species))

tree_result <- phylo.maker(
  sp.list = phylo_input,
  tree = GBOTB.extended.TPL,   # mega-phylogeny backbone bundled with the package
  scenarios = "S3"             # scenario 3 — matches the paper's approach
)

tree <- tree_result$scenario.3

length(tree$tip.label)
nrow(phylo_input)

missing_species <- setdiff(phylo_input$species, tree$tip.label)
missing_species

phylo_input <- phylo_input %>%
  mutate(species_underscore = gsub(" ", "_", species))

missing_species <- setdiff(phylo_input$species_underscore, tree$tip.label)
length(missing_species)
missing_species

```

#phylogenetic signal
```{r}
install.packages("phytools")
library(phytools)

P50_species_median <- P50_species_median %>%
  mutate(species_underscore = gsub(" ", "_", scientificName))

trait_vector <- setNames(P50_species_median$P50_median, P50_species_median$species_underscore)

species_with_data <- intersect(names(trait_vector), tree$tip.label)

tree_pruned <- keep.tip(tree, species_with_data)
trait_vector_pruned <- trait_vector[species_with_data]

length(tree_pruned$tip.label) == length(trait_vector_pruned)

lambda_result <- phylosig(tree_pruned, trait_vector_pruned, method = "lambda", test = TRUE)
lambda_result

# keep one tip per genus
genus_lookup <- phylo_input %>%
  dplyr::select(species_underscore, genus) %>%
  distinct()

one_per_genus <- genus_lookup %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(species_underscore)

tree_genus <- keep.tip(tree_pruned, intersect(one_per_genus, tree_pruned$tip.label))
trait_vector_genus <- trait_vector_pruned[tree_genus$tip.label]

lambda_genus <- phylosig(tree_genus, trait_vector_genus, method = "lambda", test = TRUE)
lambda_genus
```

# phylogenetic eigenvector maps
```{r}
install.packages("MPSEM")
library(MPSEM)

tree_graph <- Phylo2DirectedGraph(tree_pruned)

pem_result <- PEM.build(tree_graph)

pem_scores <- as.data.frame(pem_result$u)
pem_scores$species_underscore <- rownames(pem_scores)

P50_with_pem <- P50_filtered %>%
  mutate(species_underscore = gsub(" ", "_", scientificName)) %>%
  left_join(pem_scores, by = "species_underscore")

pem_cols <- grep("^V_", colnames(P50_with_pem), value = TRUE)

correlations <- sapply(pem_cols, function(col) {
  cor(P50_with_pem[[col]], P50_with_pem$P50, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
})

top_pem <- names(sort(abs(correlations), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]

model_data <- P50_with_pem %>%
  dplyr::select(P50, all_of(top_pem))


```

# random forest models
```{r}

# build Phylogenetic Eigenvector Maps (PEM)

install.packages("MPSEM")
library(MPSEM)

tree_graph <- Phylo2DirectedGraph(tree_pruned)
pem_result <- PEM.build(tree_graph)

pem_scores <- as.data.frame(pem_result$u)
colnames(pem_scores)  # confirm naming - rename if not "V_" prefixed
# if needed: colnames(pem_scores) <- paste0("V_", seq_len(ncol(pem_scores)))
pem_scores$species_underscore <- rownames(pem_scores)

P50_with_pem <- P50_filtered %>%
  mutate(species_underscore = gsub(" ", "_", scientificName)) %>%
  left_join(pem_scores, by = "species_underscore")


# feature selection - correlate PEM columns with trait

pem_cols <- grep("^V_", colnames(P50_with_pem), value = TRUE)

correlations <- sapply(pem_cols, function(col) {
  cor(P50_with_pem[[col]], P50_with_pem$P50, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
})

top_pem <- names(sort(abs(correlations), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
top_pem_reduced <- names(sort(abs(correlations), decreasing = TRUE))[1:15]


# train/valid/test split by species (avoid leakage)

install.packages("h2o")
library(h2o)
h2o.init()

set.seed(123)
unique_species <- unique(P50_with_pem$species_underscore)
n <- length(unique_species)
shuffled <- sample(unique_species)

train_sp <- shuffled[1:floor(0.70 * n)]
valid_sp <- shuffled[(floor(0.70 * n) + 1):floor(0.85 * n)]
test_sp  <- shuffled[(floor(0.85 * n) + 1):n]

# train model with FULL PEM set (50 cols) - baseline
train_data <- P50_with_pem %>% dplyr::filter(species_underscore %in% train_sp) %>% dplyr::select(P50, all_of(top_pem))
valid_data <- P50_with_pem %>% dplyr::filter(species_underscore %in% valid_sp) %>% dplyr::select(P50, all_of(top_pem))
test_data  <- P50_with_pem %>% dplyr::filter(species_underscore %in% test_sp)  %>% dplyr::select(P50, all_of(top_pem))

train_h2o <- as.h2o(train_data)
valid_h2o <- as.h2o(valid_data)
test_h2o  <- as.h2o(test_data)

rf_model <- h2o.randomForest(
  x = top_pem, y = "P50",
  training_frame = train_h2o, validation_frame = valid_h2o,
  ntrees = 300, max_depth = 50, nfolds = 8,
  stopping_metric = "MSE", seed = 123
)

perf <- h2o.performance(rf_model, newdata = test_h2o)
perf

predictions <- as.data.frame(h2o.predict(rf_model, test_h2o))
actual <- test_data$P50
predicted <- predictions$predict

mae <- mean(abs(actual - predicted))
r_squared <- cor(actual, predicted)^2
percent_bias <- 100 * sum(predicted - actual) / sum(actual)

plot(actual, predicted, xlab = "Observed P50", ylab = "Predicted P50")
abline(0, 1, col = "red")

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: Train model with REDUCED PEM set (15 cols) - retain species labels
# ============================================================
train_data <- P50_with_pem %>% dplyr::filter(species_underscore %in% train_sp) %>% dplyr::select(P50, all_of(top_pem_reduced))
valid_data <- P50_with_pem %>% dplyr::filter(species_underscore %in% valid_sp) %>% dplyr::select(P50, all_of(top_pem_reduced))
test_data  <- P50_with_pem %>% dplyr::filter(species_underscore %in% test_sp)  %>%
  dplyr::select(species_underscore, P50, all_of(top_pem_reduced))  # <-- keeps species label

train_h2o <- as.h2o(train_data)
valid_h2o <- as.h2o(valid_data)
test_h2o  <- as.h2o(test_data %>% dplyr::select(-species_underscore))  # drop label just for h2o input

rf_model_reduced <- h2o.randomForest(
  x = top_pem_reduced, y = "P50",
  training_frame = train_h2o, validation_frame = valid_h2o,
  ntrees = 300, max_depth = 50, nfolds = 8,
  stopping_metric = "MSE", seed = 123
)

perf_reduced <- h2o.performance(rf_model_reduced, newdata = test_h2o)
perf_reduced

predictions_reduced <- as.data.frame(h2o.predict(rf_model_reduced, test_h2o))
actual <- test_data$P50
predicted_reduced <- predictions_reduced$predict
test_species <- test_data$species_underscore   # <-- for residual/phylo step later

mae_reduced <- mean(abs(actual - predicted_reduced))
r_squared_reduced <- cor(actual, predicted_reduced)^2
percent_bias_reduced <- 100 * sum(predicted_reduced - actual) / sum(actual)

plot(actual, predicted_reduced, xlab = "Observed P50", ylab = "Predicted P50")
abline(0, 1, col = "red")

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: Compare models, choose winner
# ============================================================
cat("Original (50 PEM):  R2 =", r_squared, " Bias% =", percent_bias, " MAE =", mae, "\n")
cat("Reduced (15 PEM):   R2 =", r_squared_reduced, " Bias% =", percent_bias_reduced, " MAE =", mae_reduced, "\n")

top_pem_final <- top_pem_reduced   # <-- you chose reduced


# Residuals + phylogenetic signal check (on test set)

library(phytools)

residual_df <- data.frame(
  species_underscore = test_species,
  predicted = predicted_reduced,
  actual = actual,
  residual = predicted_reduced - actual
)

residual_vector <- setNames(residual_df$residual, residual_df$species_underscore)
species_with_residuals <- intersect(names(residual_vector), tree_pruned$tip.label)
tree_residuals <- keep.tip(tree_pruned, species_with_residuals)
residual_vector_pruned <- residual_vector[species_with_residuals]

lambda_residuals <- phylosig(tree_residuals, residual_vector_pruned, method = "lambda", test = TRUE)
lambda_residuals

# empirical uncertainty bins (simplified SEP alternative)

residual_df <- residual_df %>%
  mutate(pred_bin = ntile(predicted, 3))

bin_summary <- residual_df %>%
  group_by(pred_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    bin_range = paste(round(min(predicted), 1), "to", round(max(predicted), 1)),
    residual_sd = sd(residual),
    residual_mean = mean(residual),
    n = n()
  )

bin_summary


# train final model on FULL dataset using winning PEM set

full_data_h2o <- as.h2o(P50_with_pem %>% dplyr::select(P50, all_of(top_pem_final)))

final_model <- h2o.randomForest(
  x = top_pem_final, y = "P50",
  training_frame = full_data_h2o,
  ntrees = 300, max_depth = 50, nfolds = 8,
  stopping_metric = "MSE", seed = 123
)
```

# impute values
```{r}

# Identify species missing P50 data

species_with_p50 <- unique(P50_with_pem$species_underscore)
all_tree_species <- tree$tip.label   # all 133 species on your full tree

missing_p50_species <- setdiff(all_tree_species, species_with_p50)
length(missing_p50_species)


# rebuild PEM using the FULL tree (all species, not just those with data)

tree_graph_full <- Phylo2DirectedGraph(tree)
pem_result_full <- PEM.build(tree_graph_full)

pem_scores_full <- as.data.frame(pem_result_full$u)
colnames(pem_scores_full)  # confirm naming again for this new object
pem_scores_full$species_underscore <- rownames(pem_scores_full)

missing_pem <- pem_scores_full %>%
  dplyr::filter(species_underscore %in% missing_p50_species) %>%
  dplyr::select(species_underscore, all_of(top_pem_final))

nrow(missing_pem)  # should match length(missing_p50_species), assuming all made it onto tree


missing_h2o <- as.h2o(missing_pem %>% dplyr::select(-species_underscore))

imputed_predictions <- as.data.frame(h2o.predict(final_model, missing_h2o))

imputed_results <- data.frame(
  species_underscore = missing_pem$species_underscore,
  P50_imputed = imputed_predictions$predict
)

# assign each imputed value to the closest bin range from bin_summary,
# using the same predicted-value cutpoints ntile() created on your test set
imputed_results <- imputed_results %>%
  mutate(pred_bin = case_when(
    P50_imputed <= quantile(residual_df$predicted, 1/3) ~ 1,
    P50_imputed <= quantile(residual_df$predicted, 2/3) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 3
  )) %>%
  left_join(bin_summary %>% dplyr::select(pred_bin, residual_sd), by = "pred_bin") %>%
  mutate(
    lower_95 = P50_imputed - 1.96 * residual_sd,
    upper_95 = P50_imputed + 1.96 * residual_sd
  )

imputed_results

observed_final <- P50_species_median %>%
  dplyr::select(scientificName, P50_median) %>%
  mutate(species_underscore = gsub(" ", "_", scientificName),
         source = "observed") %>%
  dplyr::select(species_underscore, P50_value = P50_median, source)

imputed_final <- imputed_results %>%
  mutate(source = "imputed") %>%
  dplyr::select(species_underscore, P50_value = P50_imputed, source)

P50_complete <- bind_rows(observed_final, imputed_final)

P50_complete

P50_complete %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = P50_value, fill = source)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 20) +
  labs(
    x = "P50 (MPa)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Data source",
    title = "Observed vs. Imputed P50 values"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# the model is predicting nearly the same value for most of the 60 missing species
# RF's known tendency to regress toward the mean at the extremes 

```
